title: How to stop being skinny fat
summary: Transcript is junk (garbled auto-captions), so this note relies on the description: skinny fat is not a body type but a sign of metabolic distress and a poor lean-mass-to-fat ratio. Skinny-fat lifters should put most of their effort into training, with diet and hormones becoming relevant once muscle is added.
claims: Being skinny fat is not a body type but a sign of metabolic distress and a poor lean mass to adipose tissue ratio
Unlike people who are simply fat or skinny, who should mostly focus on diet, skinny-fat individuals should put the bulk of their effort into diligent training
Food intake control and hormonal environment help, but truly matter once muscle is in the mix
